nameOrigin: thin, sharp side of a blade

pokedexEntries.x: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

pokedexEntries.or: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

pokedexEntries.y: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person’s arm and drains that person’s life energy completely.

pokedexEntries.as: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person’s arm and drains that person’s life energy completely.

pokedexEntries.sw: Honedge’s soul once belonged to a person who was killed a long time ago by the sword that makes up Honedge’s body.

pokedexEntries.sh: The blue eye on the sword’s handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people’s lives away.
